parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. It cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the vSwitch resides.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query the IDs of all regions that support vSwitches.

parameters.name: VSwitchIds
parameters.description: A list of vSwitches in the VPC.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

> Call [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) to view the details of the VPC.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The ID of the zone where the vSwitch resides.
